result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner's text is nearly illegible due to low contrast. Otherwise no visually broken layout, clipping, or missing elements were detected; partially visible carousel items and the bottom card are intentional scroll indicators.

issues.description: Promotional banner text has very low contrast: the white heading '3 free deliveries for you' and the even lighter secondary text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' sit on a pale mint-green background and are difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or change the heading and secondary text to a dark green/black with sufficient contrast (at least 4.5:1 for body text), ensuring the promo code and minimum-order condition are clearly legible.
